name: Okujou de Iinchou ga Dappun Shiteru no o Mokugeki Shite Shimatta Ken
original_name: 屋上で委員長が脱糞してるのを目撃してしまった件
source:
Nakamura was taking a nap on the roof, but was awakened by something strange --
Sakurai, the representative form his class, was shitting on the roof!
A good ol' roof poop, as it were.
Anyway, he's into it so he starts watching her do it every day.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE276154.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
中村正在屋顶上小睡，却被奇怪的东西吵醒了——
班级代表樱井在屋顶上拉屎了！
可以说是一个很好的屋顶粪便。
不管怎样，他很喜欢，所以他开始每天看着她这样做。

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE276154.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
